sections.title: Risk-ranked audit plan
sections.sql: select name,owner,risk,due,status,awaiting_review,outstanding_requests,open_actions from audit_plan order by risk desc,name

sections.title: Evidence to chase
sections.sql: select engagement,name,owner,due,days_overdue from evidence_chase order by days_overdue desc,name

sections.title: Action follow-up
sections.sql: select engagement,name,owner,severity,due,state,days_overdue from action_follow_up order by days_overdue desc,name

sections.title: Independent review queue
sections.sql: select engagement,name,preparer,result,gap from review_queue order by due,name

sections.title: Documentation flags
sections.sql: select rule,record,gap from compliance_gaps order by rule,record
sections.note: Scoped record checks only. See docs/compliance.md for sources and limits.
